PhD, Master of Advanced Studies and Certificate of Specialization
PhD
Have you already been enrolled at the UNIGE and wish to come back to start a PhD?
When should I apply for re-enrollment for a PhD?
You can apply for re-enrollment at any point during the year.
Exception: if you wish to do a PhD at the Geneva School of Economics and Management (GSEM), you must apply before February 28 (for most programs).
Admission requirements for re-enrollment in a PhD
See the study regulations of the chosen faculty/institute/center.
Required level of French
No particular level of French is required for a PhD. See the study regulations for the chose program to check the required language levels.
Procedure
Follow the procedure for your chosen faculty/institute:
Faculty of Science
Find a professor willing to direct your thesis and ask them for a certificate that attests it;
For the PhD in Life Sciences, contact the program coordinator. At the same time, find a thesis advisor; their faculty will be the one you enroll in. You will then receive a PhD advisement certificate mentioning the exact starting date (semester) of your thesis and any given equivalence;
Request your re-enrollment on the Admissions Office online platform;
Exception: if you wish to apply for the MAS in hospital pharmacy, check MAS pharmacie hospitalière - Pharmacie à Genève aux HUG - HUG (FR).
Faculty of Medicine
Request your re-enrollment on the Admissions Office online platform.
Faculty of Humanities
Find a professor willing to direct your thesis;
If you are accepted, they will apply for your thesis registration;
Request your re-enrollment on the Admissions Office online platform, joining the admission letter.
Geneva School of Economics and Management (GSEM)
See the web page with GSEM's PhDs;
Request your re-enrollment on the Admissions Office online platform.
Geneva School of Social Sciences (SdS)
Find a professor willing to direct your thesis and ask them for a certificate that attests it;
Request your re-enrollment on the Admissions Office online platform.
Faculty of Law
If you wish be admitted to the PhD of Laws program, you must meet the admission requirements set out in the Faculty's Rules of Studies. You must have already obtained the agreement of a professor on the basis of a thesis proposal. When you apply, you will need to send a letter of agreement signed by a professor of the Faculty, together with your thesis proposal.
If you are not already in contact with a professor, you can contact one whose area of expertise you feel is relevant to your subject, to ask if they can supervise your thesis. If so, you can apply. Professors are free to accept or reject new thesis directorships.
A list of our professors and their fields of study (FR) is available.
Then:
Request your re-enrollment on the Admissions Office online platform.
Faculty of Theology
Find a professor from the Faculty of Theology (FR) who might be interested in your research subject and being your thesis advisor;
Contact them and provide them with a preliminary thesis project (one to three pages), your resume and a cover letter;
If your research project interests them, ask them for a written certificate attesting that they will direct your thesis;
Request your re-enrollment on the Admissions Office online platform;
If you have any questions, please contact Christophe Pisteur, academic advisor for PhDs in theology.
Faculty of Psychology and Educational Sciences (FPSE)
Find a professor willing to direct your thesis and ask for the PhD form, signed by them;
Request your re-enrollment on the Admissions Office online platform.
Faculty of Translation and Interpreting
Request your re-enrollment on the Admissions Office online platform.
Global Studies Institute
Find two lecturers (1 at GSI and 1 in one of our partner faculties, i.e. Medicine, Law, Humanities, Social Sciences, Economics & Management or Science) who are likely to be interested in your field of research and willing to be your thesis co-directors;
2. Contact them with a preliminary thesis proposal (one to three pages), resume and cover letter;
3. If they are interested in your research project, ask them for written confirmation that they have agreed to supervise your thesis;
4. Request your re-enrollment on the Admissions Office online platform.
If you have any questions, please contact Maud Preher, Academic Advisor for Interdisciplinary PhDs in Global Studies.
Master of Advanced Studies (MAS) and Certificate of Specialization (CS)
Have you already been enrolled at the UNIGE and wish to come back to start a MAS or a CS?
Apply on the Admissions Office online platform.
When should I apply for a MAS or CS?
For the Fall semester: between January 15 and July 31;
For the Spring semester: between September 15 and November 30.
No re-enrollment application can be submitted after the deadline.
Important: some faculties have a specific deadline or additional procedure. See the list "Specific deadlines and additional procedures".
Admission requirements for re-enrollment in a MAS or CS
See the study regulations of the chosen faculty/institute/center.
Required level of French
For Master of Advanced Studies programs: no particular level of French required. However, the study regulations can set specific required language levels.
For Certificate of Specialization programs: the faculty/institute/center may require the French exam, depending on the program.
Special deadlines and additional procedures
The following faculties have specific deadlines.
If you do not meet these deadlines or if your application is rejected, we will not process the re-enrollment application.
